caption: The drawing, rendered in black ink on a beige or off-white background, depicts an ornate iron gate set into a brick or stone wall. The gate features intricate scrollwork and symmetrical decorative patterns, with prominent swirling shapes. At the top of the gate, there are two birds facing each other, perched on either side of a central sculpted urn that holds a leafy or floral arrangement. The left section of the drawing presents a close-up view of the upper portion of the gate, emphasizing the details of the scrollwork, birds, and urn, while the right section shows a full view of the gate within the architectural frame of a wall or portal. The bricks of the wall are detailed by short horizontal lines, and the drawing includes a border framing the two views. At the bottom, the text “GATEWAY TO COURT” is written in capital letters.
title: Iron Work on Doorway
